default.notes: Apply for a visa at a Lebanese embassy or consulate before travel — approval requirements vary by nationality.

groups.notes: GCC nationals enter Lebanon visa-free — commonly admitted for up to three months; confirm the exact allowance on arrival.
Free one-month tourist visa issued on arrival at Beirut airport and other border posts, extendable to three months at General Security before it expires.

IL.notes: Lebanon and Israel remain formally at war — Israeli passport holders are barred, and any traveller with evidence of travel to Israel is refused entry.

SY.notes: Entry for Syrian nationals is governed by special bilateral entry categories that have tightened since 2024 — approval and documentation requirements change frequently; confirm with General Security before travel.

PS.notes: Holders of Palestinian travel documents need prior approval from Lebanese General Security — apply well in advance through a Lebanese embassy.

EG.notes: Egyptian nationals can generally obtain a visa on arrival subject to additional conditions such as proof of accommodation and funds, or residence in a GCC or Western country — confirm with General Security before travel.

LB.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Lebanese citizens.
